name: IL&FS Engineering and Construction Company Ltd

facts.business: IL&FS Engineering and Construction Company Limited is engaged in engineering and construction services.

auditor.name: M. Bhaskara Rao & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on ongoing investigations by SFIO, ED and other regulators; non-receipt of balance confirmations from some customers and vendors; non-recognition of interest expense on borrowings of Rs.460.44 Crores for the year ended March 31, 2026 and aggregate Rs.3080.33 Crores as at March 31, 2026 pursuant to NCLAT orders.

key_risks: Ongoing investigations by SFIO, ED and other regulators against IL&FS and its subsidiaries including the Company
Non-receipt of confirmation of balances from some customers and vendors
Non-recognition of interest expense on borrowings pursuant to NCLAT orders
Material uncertainty related to going concern due to continued losses, erosion of net-worth and significant reduction in income from operations
facts.related_party_note: Includes receivables from related parties (Refer note 37); Loans to related parties (Refer note 37); Pledged in favour of Infrastructure Leasing and Financial Services Limited and IL&FS Financial Services Limited; Hypothecated to Infrastructure Leasing and Financial Services Limited
